Title: Document 3
Content: Source: Letter to Nelson Rockefeller, Republican governor of New York, `text(February 6, 1971)`.

This letter is written to you by a law abiding citizen who feels she is discriminated against in favor of dope addicts and welfare cheats. I am a widow who lives alone, works every `text(day)`, pays taxes and lives by the rules. I get very little from my taxes when I can no longer walk on the streets and when I am afraid in my own home... Sorry this letter is not typed. My typewriter was stolen.
